headline: MTN Ghana Nine-Month Profit Rises 43% to US$664 Million
summary: MTN Ghana and its mobile money division reported an after-tax profit of approximately US$664 million for the first nine months, up 43% on revenues of about US$1.98 billion.
why: Telecommunications and mobile money platforms are critical indicators of financial inclusion and digital economy expansion in West Africa.

impacts.name: MTN Ghana
impacts.why: Significant profit and revenue expansion point to robust commercial performance.
